parameters.query:
SELECT alarm_type, severity, alarm_timestamp, processing_status FROM network_alarms
WHERE device_name = $1 AND alarm_id <> $2::uuid
ORDER BY alarm_timestamp DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT device_type, vendor, model, location, network_role, ip_address::text AS ip_address, management_ip::text AS management_ip
FROM network_devices WHERE device_name = $1

INSERT INTO agent_execution_logs
  (incident_id, alarm_id, agent_name, execution_status, error_message, input_data, output_data, duration_ms, started_at, completed_at)
VALUES ($1::uuid, NULLIF($2, '')::uuid, 'root_cause_analysis', $3, NULLIF($4, ''), $5::jsonb, $6::jsonb,
  (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($8::timestamptz - $7::timestamptz)) * 1000)::int, $7::timestamptz, $8::timestamptz)
RETURNING log_id
